cards.scope: Complete the XLM parity and threat model
cards.evidenceText: Design decision: use one Stellar account per vault; first funding may use wallet-signed CreateAccount or a native Payment to avoid public-account precreation griefing. Connected-wallet support for both remains to verify. XRC source can represent XLM/USD; its generic defaults include received-rate floor 3 and freshness up to 120 seconds, but live XLM source quorum and quote are unverified. The read-only IC connector refused the backend because its service-discoverability manifest is missing; the direct XRC sample is a paid update and was not called. Direct endpoint probes could not run under the local DNS sandbox. Mara Junior's first read-only audit and second Sonnet/Haiku design review are complete; open design, implementation, and release work remains. A 2-of-3 independent provider-result quorum is the Horizon target; provider selection remains unresolved and source helpers have no provider wiring. SDF public Horizon, Tatum authenticated Horizon, and Blockdaemon authenticated Horizon are research candidates; Ankr is a fourth candidate. None is validated or provisioned. Separately, a read-only mainnet XRP config check on 2026-10-27 returned Active, a $30,000 debt ceiling (3,000,000,000,000 e8s), and an explicit Linear rate curve. Decoded live values are a 128% borrow threshold, 117% liquidation ratio, 7.5% liquidation bonus, 0.2% borrowing fee, 1.5% base APR, and 132.266666666666666624% recovery target. Those differ from the XRP source constructor's $2,500 ceiling and 150%/133%/12% parameters; do not present constructor values as current live parity. XRP evidence only; no XLM registration, deployment, or live config is proved.

cards.scope: Build the Stellar rail and independent address and transaction vectors
cards.evidenceText: Commit bdb7d742 preserves omitted optional `id` and `paging_token` fields in the deterministic Horizon operations transform; pure tests cover each field alone and explicit null, but are unrun. Commit 54c175cf adds bounded operations requests to each configured origin and fixed-slot three-provider custody deposit observations after network-root validation. Scoped rustfmt/diff checks passed; there are no Cargo tests, live outcalls, quorum, credit, or admission. This fetch fanout does not establish provider independence or live evidence freshness. Earlier latest-ledger reserve quorum and deposit-evidence helpers remain pure decision logic only.

cards.scope: Add stable state and an XLM launch guard
cards.evidenceText: The latest-ledger reserve and deposit-evidence modules remain pure, uncompiled decision logic. Commit bdb7d742 adds optional operations identity preservation with unrun tests; commit 54c175cf adds bounded provider fetches and fixed-slot observations after network-root validation. No quorum/credit/admission or atomic state mutation is integrated. Credit/key/receipt/status state remains dormant. Generated Candid and frontend declarations remain stale after the key setter change. Config remains Frozen; XLM is not registered, deployed, or admitted as collateral.

cards.scope: Implement verified XLM deposits and borrowing
cards.evidenceText: Pure source provides reserve-agreement and CreateAccount/native-Payment deposit-evidence decisions. Commits bdb7d742 and 54c175cf preserve optional operation identity and fetch bounded three-provider custody observations after network-root validation; scoped format/diff checks only. No Cargo tests or live outcalls. There is still no quorum/credit/admission, open/confirm endpoint, or atomic state mutation. WP3 remains blocked; independent provider trust, live freshness/oracle, credit lifecycle, and testnet/frontend remain open. No live provider/oracle proof, XLM admission, or deployment is proved.

cards.scope: Implement XLM claims, exits, and liquidation handling
cards.evidenceText: The pure deposit-evidence helper reserves unsettled claim gross plus fee, but does not implement live claim settlement or payout. Transaction-status transport preserves fee and normalized not-found evidence in source; its 39 policy tests remain unrun. No Cargo/dfx test or live call has verified transport or claim reservations. Provider independence and live evidence freshness remain unresolved, so WP4 stays blocked. The XRP post-sign status race is a separate reuse caution, not an XLM-specific required gate. Reserve/oracle checks, testnet, frontend, and release remain open. Frozen config prevents XLM admission.

cards.scope: Integrate Candid, user flows, and operator monitoring
cards.evidenceText: Earlier Candid regeneration and compatibility checks passed. Source-only key setter/getter changes the Candid interface; generated `.did` and frontend declarations remain stale pending canonical regeneration. Multi-operation receipt/status and frontend guard changes have not been compiled. Full XLM frontend integration and supported deposit/withdrawal/claim flows remain open.

cards.scope: Validate the rail with tests, independent review, and Stellar testnet evidence
cards.evidenceText: Earlier focused `chains::stellar` Cargo tests passed 34/34 before these commits. Commit bdb7d742 adds pure tests for preserving optional `id` and `paging_token` (including explicit null), unrun. Commit 54c175cf adds bounded per-origin operations fetches and fixed-slot three-provider custody observations after network-root validation; scoped rustfmt/diff checks passed, but no Cargo/dfx tests or live outcalls ran. This is fetch capability, not provider independence, quorum, live freshness, credit, or admission. Reserve helper's four tests and status policy's 39 tests remain unrun. Remaining blockers include provider trust/freshness, deposit credit, claim settlement, oracle, frontend/testnet, and release. WP3/WP4/release remain blocked; no live proof, admission, or deployment.

cards.scope: Prepare deployment, configuration, and activation evidence
cards.evidenceText: Mara Junior's first read-only audit and second Sonnet/Haiku design review are complete; a separate transaction-status review file is underway. A provider network-binding agent is also working. Broader release work remains open: current reserve freshness/oracle validation, deposit and claim lifecycles, testnet/frontend integration, exact-head validation, artifact review, and rollback/monitoring. Release is blocked. The live XRP post-sign status race remains a separate XRP reuse caution, not a required XLM gate. No live provider/oracle proof, deployment, or activation is proved.
